home.eyebrow: A new signal fires every few minutes
home.heroSubtitle: Mir'aa links your account to a professional trading team — what happens on their side happens on yours, automatically.
home.howTitle: From the expert's signal to a trade in your account
home.step1Body: Trade-only permission — no withdrawals, no deposits. Your keys are encrypted immediately and no human ever sees them.
home.step2Body: Choose the max share of your capital any single trade can use. The system blocks anything beyond it automatically.
home.step3Body: Every signal executes in your account within fractions of a second, and you track it live from your dashboard.
home.featMainTitle: Your risk limit isn't a number on a screen — it's a real constraint on every order
home.featMainBody: Many platforms just display a "risk limit". Ours is checked before any order reaches Binance, and rejected before execution if it's exceeded — not after.
home.feat1Body: A repeated error on your account halts execution for you alone, immediately.
home.feat2Body: Every signal has a unique ID — it executes exactly once, even across retries.
home.feat3Body: Every trade is logged with its time, source, and actual Binance result.
home.feat4Body: Watch each trade's status change in front of you, no page refresh.
home.secTitle: Your money always stays in your own account
home.sec1: We can't withdraw or deposit — trade-only permission, enforced by Binance's own settings
home.sec2: API keys are encrypted with AES-256 the moment they're entered, never stored as plaintext
home.sec3: Admin permissions are checked against the database on every request, not just from a token
home.tgBody: The bot verifies your subscription automatically and adds you to the channel — access is revoked automatically if you cancel.
home.finalCtaTitle: Ready to see the mirror happen in your account?
home.finalCtaBody: No credit card to sign up — connect your account and watch the signals before you switch on auto-copy.
